mount.note: Human eye height on a sensor mast, at Tashon's request (2026-10-20); the spec's original mount was 0.5 m high, 0.32 m forward.

thermal.note: Modelled on a FLIR Boson 320 with a 50 deg HFOV lens (320x256, NETD under 50 mK); recorded on the 15 Hz sensor clock. PNG value = kelvin x 10.

air_temperature.note: Body-mounted thermocouple: first-order lag, reads the air at the robot body.

lidar.note: Planar 360 degree time-of-flight scanner on the robot's back, in the body's collision band (0.25 to 0.55 m), modelled on a 2D scanner such as the RPLIDAR S2 (10 Hz, 0.5 degree steps here, about 1 cm noise). Added 2026-10-20 at Tashon's request: the camera on its 1.6 m mast cannot see the floor within about 2 m, so the brain had no near-field geometry. Ray casts physics colliders, so furniture reads as its collider box.
